title: Reliable cancer-dependency prediction
summary: Predict cancer dependencies across biological contexts from public DepMap CRISPR screens, through comparable improvements and bounded exploration; assess accuracy, coverage and practical experimental relevance. Results are computational hypotheses about cancer models, not clinical advice.

credit.policy: Preserve artifact authorship, data citations, agent provenance, negative results and independent reproduction. Name people only with agreement; no automatic authorship promise.

review.note: Maintainer: @Mister-Meeseeks; pre-release agent trials and research contributions are open. Scientific review and independent replay are required before accepting results, not before starting a bounded contribution. Data/model reuse follows DATA_LICENSE.md.

requirements.note: Python 3.12 with the pinned requirements.lock; no GPU. Checks and compact replay use committed extracts, no download. Broader fitting needs about 1.2 GB of pinned DepMap 24Q2 files (src/fetch_data.py, CC BY 4.0) plus the transfer trial's recorded inputs; the 4 GB disk figure is a planning estimate.
